paragraphs.A: Honeybees live in colonies of up to fifty thousand individuals...
paragraphs.B: When a forager finds food, she returns to the hive and performs a figure-eight movement known as the waggle dance...

questions.text: Bees use movement to share the location of food.

brochure_bees.title: Museum brochure
brochure_bees.text: Look at paragraph B. How does the forager tell the others where the food is?
